text: Granddaughter is 10, staying with me this week. Nose has been running all day, then blocked, and she's been sneezing non stop since about teatime. I checked her over for any rash because her mum always says to and there's nothing, no spots anwhere. I'm just shattered and she can't settle because she can't breath through her nose properly to sleep. Is there anything I can give her for the blocked nose at her age or do I just ride it out
